test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What will be the interest on ₹6250 for 3 years if interest accrues at 12% simple interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principle (P) = Rs. 6250 

Rate of interest (R) = 12% per annum 

Time period (T) = 3 years 

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

SI = (6250 × 12 × 3)/100

⇒ SI = 225000/100

⇒ SI = Rs. 2250

**∴ The Simple Interest will be Rs. 2250.**
